default.notes: A short-stay visa is required — apply online through Albania's e-Visa portal (e-visa.al) or at an Albanian embassy; holders of a valid multiple-entry Schengen, UK or US visa may instead enter visa-free for up to 90 days.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 90 days within any 180-day period under Albania's waiver list, which broadly follows the EU's Schengen visa-free list plus regional and bilateral agreements.

AL.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Albanian citizens.

US.notes: US citizens may enter visa-free and stay for up to one year — Albania's most generous waiver.

CN.notes: Chinese citizens have entered visa-free under a seasonal waiver covering roughly March to November in recent years — confirm the current window on e-visa.al before travel.

RU.notes: The summer seasonal waiver previously offered to Russian citizens is no longer in force — apply for an e-Visa, or enter visa-free with a valid multiple-entry Schengen, UK or US visa.

IN.notes: Albania has offered short seasonal waivers for Indian tourists in some summers; outside those windows apply for an e-Visa — or enter visa-free with a valid multiple-entry Schengen, UK or US visa.
